en:
Oh, Tenko!
I wanted to ask you something...

<CLT=cltMIND>We asked Tenko about what happened
in the Game Room—

<CLT=cltMIND>But she only confirmed what Maki had told
us, and didn't provide any new information.
I see...

I knew it! Gonta would be the most suspicious
since he locked himself in the A/V Room!
Not to mention he's also a male!
Um... Are you submitting that as evidence?

By the way, how has your investigation
been going?
I haven't done any investigating!
What?

Hey, degenerate! Don't give me that face!
I've been doing something else!
I've been watching Angie!
Watching Angie...?

We agreed to investigate with one other
person, right?

But Angie's just been wandering around
alone!
Ooh, that's why you're with Angie?

I don't wanna suspect anyone, either...but
girls' lives are at stake here.

For an investigation like this to work,
we have to trust each other...
<CLT=cltMIND>Oooh, she does NOT look happy right now.

Don't act all high and mighty with me, you
two-faced degenerate!
S-Sorry, that wasn't my intention...

Besides, it doesn't matter if I suspect
Angie or not...

It doesn't change the fact that we all agreed
to work together for this investigation!
You're not gonna investigate, Angie?

Investigating is important, but I gotta say
my prayers to Atua, too.

O Atua... Please let Rantaro enter heaven
safe and sound.
I suppose...a prayer couldn't hurt...

Rantaro died in such a gruesome way...
Would he be able to go to heaven in peace?
It'd be nice if he could...
Don't worry, I'll pray hard.

If I pray hard enough, I'll earn enough points
to become a platinum disciple.
Sounds like a credit card rewards program...

O Atua... Please let Rantaro enter heaven
safe and sound.

<CLT=cltMIND>I still haven't talked to some people yet.
I need to go find them.
<CLT=cltMIND>This door only opens a crack...

<CLT=cltMIND>In front of me is the library's rear entrance,
and this door here connects to the A/V room.
<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi should be in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It doesn't seem like anyone's here. I need to
find the others I haven't talked to yet...

<CLT=cltMIND>I shouldn't be going back to the library. I need
to find the others I haven't talked to yet...

<CLT=cltMIND>So this duct connects to the library from
the classroom next to the stairs...

<CLT=cltMIND>But Shuichi and I were on lookout in
the classroom...

<CLT=cltMIND>I doubt anyone could've passed through
here.
<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi should be in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>This monitor currently displays a paused
countdown for the time limit...

<CLT=cltMIND>When the countdown stopped, all that obnoxious
noise stopped, too.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what would've happened if the
time limit had expired...
